title: Preview and open the files the agent sent you
done: That is it: the file opens in the preview; open it in its own app or show it in the Finder from there.

steps.caption: When the agent sends you a file, For you lists it, with the agent's line about it.
Click it to preview it here: text, pictures and PDFs.
From the preview, open it in its own app, or show it in the Finder or the file manager.
Discuss asks the agent about the file, as for any row.
Close the preview when you are done.
Your turn: click the file to preview it.
